editorial:
Get ready for fast cars, sharp suits, and nonstop action as Frank Martin returns to the criminal underworld in France. You follow the famous driver as he gets pulled into a dangerous revenge plan led by Anna, a woman with a personal score to settle against ruthless Russian traffickers. The stakes get personal when Frank’s father is kidnapped, forcing him to use every skill behind the wheel and in hand-to-hand combat. The movie moves quickly, mixing sleek style with loud fights, car chases, and tense standoffs. It feels like a throwback action ride built for fans who want simple thrills and cool stunts.

The action is the main draw, with plenty of punches, crashes, and stylish escapes, though the story can feel thin and some characters lack depth. Ed Skrein brings energy to Frank, while Anna adds a strong revenge angle that keeps things moving. If you want deep drama, this may not be your pick, but if you want easy weekend entertainment, it works well. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Frank tracks down the traffickers and fights through their guards to reach his father on the yacht. Anna confronts the Russian crime boss who ruined her life, and their showdown turns deadly. Frank helps free the kidnapped women and shuts down the operation, while Anna finally gets her revenge. After the chaos, Frank and his father escape safely, and Anna walks away with her freedom, leaving Frank ready for his next dangerous job.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves fast cars, fight scenes, and simple action thrills.
